summary: Specifies version 4 of the Network File System protocol, a distributed file system that builds on NFS versions 2 and 3. It folds in file locking and mounting and adds features such as stronger security and better performance over the internet. It is a proposed standard and was replaced by RFC 7530.

eli5.summary: You can keep your files on one computer and open them from another as if they were right there. This memo describes the fourth version of the system that does that.
